probes.name: T-range
probes.subject: tests/db_guard.py
probes.note: 🔴 A code inside pytest's own 0-5 range makes a contended session indistinguishable from an ordinary verdict.

probes.name: T-uniq
probes.subject: tests/db_guard.py
probes.note: 🔴 A key ignoring its input makes two databases share one lock — the session and the gate would contend forever. Determinism stays GREEN under this (a constant IS deterministic), so the two claims are separately witnessed.

probes.name: T-signed
probes.subject: tests/db_guard.py
probes.note: 🔴 pg_try_advisory_lock takes a SIGNED bigint; an unsigned key overflows the column. Determinism and uniqueness both stay green.

probes.name: T-halves
probes.subject: tests/db_guard.py
probes.note: 🔴 Getting the split wrong makes the CONTENDED path find no holder and report holder_pid=- forever — which reads exactly like a clean run.

probes.name: T-oid
probes.subject: tests/db_guard.py
probes.note: 🔴 An unmasked objid exceeds the oid column.

probes.name: T-suffix
probes.subject: tests/db_guard.py
probes.note: 🔴 The separator is load-bearing: db_support asserts the resolved name ENDS WITH _<role>. Password rendering is untouched here, so that claim stays green.

probes.name: T-password
probes.subject: tests/db_guard.py
probes.note: 🔴 str(URL) masks the password as ***, which would corrupt the connection string at the moment the guard tries to connect.

probes.name: T-len63
probes.subject: tests/db_guard.py
probes.note: 🔴 63 chars is Postgres' hard identifier limit; a name past it is silently truncated and two roles collide.

probes.name: T-ok
probes.subject: tests/db_guard.py
probes.note: 🟢 A validator that mangles a good role would suffix every database wrongly. The mutation is TARGETED at `role_2` — a value this parametrized test is the only user of, verified by git grep — because the first attempt mutated `return raw` outright and reddened all five parameter cases, which the driver correctly refused to credit under one-mutation-one-assertion.

probes.name: T-none
probes.subject: tests/db_guard.py
probes.old:
if raw is None or raw == "":
        return None
probes.new:
if raw is None or raw == "":
        return ""
probes.note: 🔴 An unset role must mean 'no isolation wanted', not empty-string isolation.

probes.name: T-token
probes.subject: tests/db_guard.py
probes.note: 🔴 AC-7's artifact (a) — THE claim no s277 battery reached, because this module was in no battery's claim_sources. Drops create_race from the token so the field loop reddens.

probes.name: T-admin
probes.subject: tests/db_guard.py
probes.note: 🔴 SD-2: a guard that locked the TARGET would still pass every other test in this file.

probes.name: T-app
probes.subject: tests/db_guard.py
probes.note: 🔴 A generic application_name makes a contention report name a pid without saying what it belongs to.

exemptions.test_the_advisory_key_is_deterministic_f: 🟢 The positive control for T-uniq, and co-falsified with it in the only direction a single-site mutation reaches. Reddening determinism ALONE needs the key to vary between two calls with the same input — a source of per-call entropy that no substitution of the existing expression provides while leaving uniqueness green. Recorded as inexpressible rather than faked (CLAUDE.md §8). Its content is what makes T-uniq's green meaningful: T-uniq replaces the input with a constant and determinism stays green, which is the only thing ruling out 'the key function broke generally'.
exemptions.test_an_empty_role_is_treated_as_unset|d: 🟢 Co-falsified with T-none: both the None branch and the empty-string branch return from the same `return None`, so any mutation of it moves both. Splitting them needs two separate early returns in the source — a refactor of the subject to suit the instrument, which is the wrong direction. T-none witnesses the shared branch.
exemptions.test_a_malformed_role_raises_instead_of_: ⚠️ INEXPRESSIBLE under one-mutation-one-assertion, measured not assumed. The test is parametrized over SIX malformed roles and the message is a single f-string, so any mutation of it reddens all six cases at once — the driver refused to credit it, correctly (run-e4… MISFIRE, blast radius 6). Narrowing it would need a conditional in the raise whose only purpose is to satisfy the instrument, which is a change to the subject to suit the measurement. Recorded rather than faked (CLAUDE.md §8). Its content is not unguarded in effect: T-ok witnesses that the validator's return path is live, and the raise itself is exercised by all six parameter cases on every ordinary suite run.
